description: One decision. The stand-in answers first; it decides alone only where the person's live grant covers the decision (grantCovers, spec grant) or its autonomy for this decision class is earned (standInMayDecide, the ladder), otherwise the person decides on a card with its recommendation. Every decision says its door (meta.classes): a two-way door is cheaply reversible, a one-way door is not. Each input of standInMayDecide has one supplier, and none of them is the stand-in's caller: tier is the item's, set by triage (TRIAGED), never by the request; expectationsMet is the item's, from its acceptGate, for an accept decision; autonomy is the ladder's rung for the class over the store's own decided decisions (its logPrecedent effects and the AUDIT_ANSWERED events dated at or before the spawn; no file kept by hand), which the harness reads when it spawns the decision (recommend if they cannot be read, so the person decides); threshold is the constant in this machine's context; confidence is the stand-in's, the only number its answer carries. Only a person's tap decides for the person, and only on the card the machine asked for: postDecisionCard asks the host to post the card (its detail carries the decision's item and address, item:<item>/<id>, where the ack and the tap go), the host's ack of that effect names the card's message id (CARD_POSTED, which the decision records once), and PERSON_DECIDED is taken only from the person with source tap:<that id> and a choice among the card's options. A tap on no card, an unposted card or another decision's card is refused; that the tap is real is checked afterwards against the platform (harness verify-taps, by another session, which names the session that relayed each tap: relayedBy on the log row). The item passes in its roles when it opens the decision (requester, triagers, workers, checkers, answerers; spec workItem, Roles), and a stand-in answer from a session holding another of them is refused; the answering session is reported to the item (STAND_IN_RECORDED), which records it as an answerer.

plan.description: Approving a plan only lets the build start; a revise or a cancel later undoes it.

accept.description: Accepting the work only moves the item on toward its merge; nothing reaches main until it merges.

merge.description: Merging puts the change on main for everyone; undoing it takes a revert.

meta.doors: Each decision class has one door, two-way (cheaply reversible) or one-way, and a decision takes its class's door when the item opens it (context.door); a class not listed here is a one-way door. The grant's checklist offers these classes, and a grant decides a one-way door only when it names that class and has the one-way-door box ticked (spec grant).

STAND_IN_ANSWERED.description: Refused unless a session or an agent sends it: the stand-in is a session or a subagent of one (harness meta.actors).

Refused from the orchestrator and from every worker that reported a run for this item (both recorded on the decision when it is spawned): only the stand-in answers, never the party whose work it judges or the one that routes it. The machine compares the ids it is given; who the sessions are is checked afterwards.

Refused when the sender, a session or an agent (harness meta.actors), already holds another role on the item (requester, triager, worker or criterion checker; the item passes them in when it opens the decision): the stand-in that answers played no other part. The person and GitHub are exempt. The machine compares the whole actor; harness verify-actors checks sessions against the platform's ledger and agents against the SubagentStart records.

Refused unless the answer is exactly a choice, a confidence between 0 and 1, and optionally a reason. An answer that carries autonomy or threshold is refused: the machine holds both. A missing confidence is refused; there is no default.

routing.description: The stand-in decides alone under the person's grant (grantCovers) when the harness's grant, read as the answer arrived (readLiveGrant: the one grant the harness holds, so a replaced grant is gone), has not ended by the answer's own time (receivedAt, before until), names this decision's class, and, for a one-way door, has the one-way-door box; the answer carries a reason, its confidence is at or above the machine's threshold, and for an accept decision the item's expectationsMet was true when it opened. Tier and autonomy do not matter there. Otherwise, as before the grant (the ladder rule, standInMayDecide), it decides alone when the tier is below 2, the class's autonomy (set at spawn from the ladder) is act, its confidence is at or above the machine's threshold, and, for an accept decision, the item's expectationsMet was true when the decision opened (false or unknown is not); otherwise the person decides. Which rule decided is recorded (authority: grant or ladder) and logged with the precedent. A decision made under the grant also reports itself to the harness (DECIDED_UNDER_GRANT, reportGrantDecision) with its choice, confidence, reason and the grant's card, and the harness keeps the row in context.granted, the one list mission control and the daily audit show the person.

awaitingPerson.description: A decision card is in front of the person, with the stand-in's recommendation. The card is the one the machine asked for (postDecisionCard); its message id arrives with the ack (CARD_POSTED), and only a tap on it decides.

CARD_POSTED.description: Refused unless a session sends it: the host session that posted the card acks the postDecisionCard effect with the card's message id (harness ack <effect> --card <cmsg id>, the only way to name it). A second ack of the effect is refused and writes nothing.
Refused unless it names one message id (cmsg_...) and this decision has no card yet: one decision, one card, recorded once.

PERSON_DECIDED.description: Refused unless the actor is a person and the source a tap.

Refused unless the tap's ref is this decision's card: the message id CARD_POSTED recorded when the host acked this decision's postDecisionCard effect. A tap before the card is posted, on another decision's card or on no card at all changes nothing. Whether the tap happened is checked afterwards against the platform (harness verify-taps).
Refused unless the choice is one of the card's options (the decision's options: approve, revise, reject).
